intro: Los Angeles has a dense public bathhouse scene: Russian-style banyas in Mid-City and West Hollywood, large Korean spas near Koreatown, and a communal sauna-and-cold-plunge club in Venice. City Spa and Voda sell walk-in day passes for rock rooms, Finnish saunas and cold plunges; Wi Spa and Olympic Spa are classic Korean bathhouses with many heat rooms; Teddy's Hot House runs timed Finnish sauna sessions with ice baths. Prices, hours and co-ed rules change, so confirm with each venue before you go.

venues.name: City Spa
venues.address: 5325 W Pico Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90019
venues.session_length: Unknown (day-use / block entry; not a timed session on the venue site)
venues.schedule: Mon 2pm-10pm; Tue-Fri 10am-10pm; Sat 8am-10pm; Sun 8am-6pm. Co-ed all day Mondays and Wednesdays; co-ed from 2pm Saturdays. 18+. Walk-ins welcome for general spa use; massage needs 24-hour reservation.
venues.notes: Rock room listed at 180-220°F, plus steam room, pool, gym, sun deck, silent room and cafe. Platza with oak venik is $15 extra; European body wash $45. FAQ says towels and toga are complimentary; the hours page still asks guests to bring towels, sandals and bathing suits.

venues.name: Voda Spa
venues.address: 7700 Santa Monica Blvd, West Hollywood, CA 90046
venues.drop_in_price: $110 facility use for non-members; $85 for members
venues.session_length: Up to 4 hours per facility-use visit
venues.schedule: Mon, Wed, Thu, Fri 1pm-11pm; Sat-Sun 11am-11pm; closed Tuesday. No reservation required for facility use; blackout dates apply. Parking behind the spa via Stanley Ave.
venues.notes: Wet and dry banyas, Finnish sauna, steam room, jacuzzi, swimming pool and relaxation room on the facility-use ticket. Massages, facials and scrubs are sold separately. Cafe and lounge on site.

venues.name: Teddy's Hot House
venues.drop_in_price: $48 first-timer pass (1 session + 1 free guest); 5-session package $200 ($40 each); 10-pack $360; 20-pack $640
venues.cold_plunge: Morozko Forge cold plunge tubs (FAQ lists about 32-50°F across three plunges)
venues.schedule: Mon-Tue and Thu-Sun 7:30am-9pm; Wed 12:30pm-9pm. Book online up to 7 days ahead; doors lock one hour before closing (arrive before 8pm for a booked session). Swimsuits required; phones off for calls in shared spaces.
venues.notes: Communal Finnish sauna with two Harvia heaters (venue cites about 195-200°F) and outdoor showers between rounds. Two towels included; lockers available. Not infrared. Memberships and private events also offered.

venues.name: Wi Spa
venues.drop_in_price: $40 regular daily admission (waived with a treatment of $160 or more)
venues.session_length: Unknown (day-use; overnight fees apply for late stays)
venues.cold_plunge: Hot and cold baths on gender floors; Ice Sauna in the co-ed jimjilbang
venues.schedule: Open 24 hours, 7 days a week. No reservation needed for day passes; book treatments ahead. Family-friendly co-ed jimjilbang; gender-segregated spa floors are clothing-optional per venue rules. Guests under 18 need a same-gender adult in spa/sauna areas.
venues.notes: Korean bathhouse with men's floor, women's floor, co-ed jimjilbang (Bulgama, Salt, Clay, Jade and Ice saunas), rooftop terrace and restaurant. Shirt and shorts provided for co-ed areas; towels and lockers included with admission. Valet parking $4 cash. First Wednesday of each month has overnight maintenance windows.

venues.name: Olympic Spa
venues.address: 3915 W Olympic Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90019
venues.drop_in_price: $60 Spa Day for non-members (online appointment only; $20 non-refundable deposit at booking); members have unlimited access
venues.session_length: Unknown (Spa Day: arrive within the booked 60-minute arrival window, then use amenities)
venues.cold_plunge: Cold water pool (core and dipping tank) plus Ice Sauna
venues.schedule: Daily 9am-9pm PT. Women-only. Closed New Year's Day, Christmas Eve/Day, and the last Wednesday of each month (plus other listed holiday closures). Valet only; entrance also listed at 946 S Norton Ave.
venues.notes: Women-only Korean spa with salt-water and relaxation pools, herbal steam, red clay sauna, ice sauna, salt room and lounges. Treatments are separate; the venue recommends arriving early to use the baths before a booked service.
